description: Catch-all spec for workflow acceptance criteria that do not map to a specific UI page. Contains backend, infrastructure, and cross-cutting criteria generated from workflow prompts. Groups are appended automatically by the workflow generation pipeline when acceptance criteria have no matching page spec.

states.name: Empty — No Catch-All Criteria Exist
states.description: The catch-all spec has no groups appended. No workflow-generated criteria have been captured that lack a matching page spec. The page shows the workflows view without any catch-all criteria sections.

transitions.name: Workflow generates unmapped criteria
transitions.description: The workflow generation pipeline appends groups when acceptance criteria have no matching page spec, transitioning to the populated state

states.name: Populated — Catch-All Criteria Groups Present
states.description: One or more groups have been appended by the workflow generation pipeline. Each group contains backend, infrastructure, or cross-cutting criteria that do not map to a specific UI page.
